visual_action: Donald Trump is in the Oval Office with a group of people dressed in Western attire. A man presents him with a special white cowboy hat from a blue "RESISTOL" box. Trump puts on the hat, and the group cheers and applauds. The camera pans to show more members of the group, including a woman in a red pantsuit and sash, smiling.

cast.name: Donald Trump
cast.evidence: Visibly on screen throughout the video, receiving a cowboy hat and putting it on.

cast.name: Rodeo World Champions
cast.evidence: The on-screen text states, 'President Trump welcomes the Rodeo World Champions into the Oval Office!' Members of the group are shown presenting a gift to Trump.

on_screen_text.text: President Trump welcomes the Rodeo World Champions into the Oval Office!

spoken_summary: A man presents a limited edition cowboy hat (number 1 of 250) to Donald Trump, noting that the liner contains the Constitution and it has a 10-karat gold flag. Trump accepts the gift, tries on the hat, and the crowd cheers enthusiastically, with someone shouting "Oh yeah!".
audio_music: The audio consists of dialogue from the event, followed by enthusiastic cheering and clapping from the attendees when Trump puts on the hat. There is no background music.
editing_pacing: The video is presented as a single, continuous shot with a slight pan across the room at the end.
central_claim: Donald Trump is being honored by the Rodeo World Champions in the Oval Office, showing his connection to and appreciation from American rural and western culture.
intended_effect: To make the viewer feel pride and to associate Donald Trump with patriotism and traditional American values as represented by rodeo culture.
